articles.title: Meta and Microsoft pull back from Claude as Anthropic transforms from partner into competitor
articles.summary: Meta and Microsoft, two of Anthropic's biggest enterprise customers, are sharply cutting their use of Claude. Microsoft slashed the monthly per-employee budget in its cloud division from $100,000 to $10,000, while Meta halved its Claude Code users to 30,000.
